title: Inflation trap: hedged internship and course-project wording for a senior role
provenance: Written for this evaluation. Not copied from any real job posting or resume.
job_description:
Senior Backend Engineer (3+ years)

You will lead the design of our microservices, own production deployments end to end and mentor junior engineers.

Responsibilities:
- Lead architecture decisions and own on-call and incident response.
- Deploy services on Kubernetes and manage infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Mentor the team.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of backend experience.
- Python, Flask or FastAPI, and SQL.
- Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and Git.

resume_text:
Candidate Juliet

Work Experience - Summer Intern
Jun 2024 - Jul 2024
- Assisted a senior engineer with a data migration by running the provided scripts and checking the output.
- Shadowed on-call engineers for one week and took notes on how incidents were handled.
- Contributed small fixes to documentation and a few unit tests.

Projects - Course Project: Inventory API
Aug 2024 - Nov 2024
- Worked in a team of 4 students; my part was writing 3 of the endpoints in Flask.
- Helped set up the Dockerfile that the team used for the demo.

Skills: Python, Flask, SQL, Docker (basic), Git
traps: Hedged verbs (assisted, shadowed, contributed, helped) must not become led, owned, architected or deployed.
The job description asks for 3+ years, on-call ownership and mentoring; the resume shows a short internship and a course project.
Docker is listed as basic and used only for a demo; it must not become production experience.
